description: The Ethir Neechal family continues where it left off. Janani & her co-sisters are breaking down barriers to carve out their space in an exciting & empowering journey as they strive to earn their family's understanding and protect relationships. Be the first to watch your favourite serial, Ethirneechal Thodargirathu – early access only on Sun NXT.

When secrets, societal pressure, and an unexpected wedding come between three childhood friends—Aadhi, Magizhini, and Madhiyazhagi—tradition and emotions clash, turning their lives upside down and testing every bond they hold dear.

Experience a unique cooking show packed with chef-inspired dishes, medicinal recipes, village-style cooking, and celebrity guests, all woven into exciting and unique weekly themes — with opportunities for viewers to participate too.

Maha, her family’s financial backbone, marries Selvam, on condition that she will continue to support her family financially even after marriage. Post which they confront challenges that put the family’s peace and happiness to test.

Things take a momentous shift when a bold & loving village girl, Malli, crosses paths with a doting father and his 6-year-old daughter who yearns for a mother's love. Join the family's journey through the nuances of love, affection & parenthood. Malli – early access only on Sun NXT.

Aathirai's unyielding passion for helping others constantly lands her in trouble, while Prabhu's self-serving actions show disregard for his own family's well-being. Follow their tumultuous journeys as fate brings them together in marriage.

Nandini is a self-assured girl who puts her family’s happiness above hers. On the other hand Surya hates his mother due to lingering resentments and deliberately bonds with Nandini to cause strife. Watch what destiny has in store for Nandini & Surya.

After losing everything to her family's greed and betrayal, Parvathi finds a new home with Dharmadurai's family. As she heals a divided household scarred by feuds, fate draws the two closer in a moving tale of love and redemption.

A powerful tale of two sisters, Thulasi and Thendral, whose bond is tested by betrayal, greed, and dark intentions. United by courage and love, they rise strong to expose the truth in their battle against injustice.
